class.name: OcgGceMakedir2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Dir2d`. Supported constructions include: - direction from vector or coordinate components; - direction from two points.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Dir2d`. ! Supported constructions include: ! - direction from vector or coordinate components; ! - direction from two points.

method.name: from_gp_Vec2d_const_ref
method.description: Normalizes the vector V and creates a direction.

method.name: from_gp_XY_const_ref
method.description: Creates a direction from a coordinate vector.

method.name: from_double_double
method.description: Creates a direction with its two cartesian coordinates.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a direction from two points.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed unit vector. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no unit vector is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
